assumptions: execution subsystem can classify an action attempt as failed
host policy selects attempt limit; no native retry count is asserted
safe_fallback: retain the pending intent and quarantine it rather than discard or repeatedly execute it after the configured attempt limit
runtime_impact: prevents poison actions from infinite automatic redelivery while preserving operator-visible recoverability
world_state_impact: failure reason, failure tick, quarantine state, and preserved pending action metadata
native_dependency: exact native retry count and terminal failure behavior remain unresolved
